summary: Lando Norris overtook Kimi Antonelli in the closing laps to secure McLaren's second consecutive victory at Zandvoort, capitalizing on a strategic pit-stop sequence that caught Mercedes off guard. Russell's sprint-race win proved meaningless as the race unfolded with multiple strategy variations, ultimately favoring Norris's calculated approach over Antonelli's defensive driving. Despite back-to-back wins, Norris admitted McLaren still lacks the pace consistency needed to challenge for the championship, signaling the title fight remains wide open heading into the final rounds.
